units.source_text: 头中将故意装作他人，一味表演恐吓的动作，反而被源氏公子看出了。

en.t: To no Chujo deliberately pretended to be someone else and kept acting as though he meant to frighten him, but Prince Genji saw through him instead.

units.source_text: 源氏公子想：“他明知是我，故意如此，真是恶作剧。”

en.t: Prince Genji thought, "He knows perfectly well that it is I, yet he is doing this on purpose. What a prank."

units.source_text: 弄清楚之后，公子觉得好笑，便抓住了他那持佩刀的手臂，狠命地拧他一把。

en.t: Once he understood what was happening, the prince found it amusing, seized the arm that held the sword at his side, and twisted it hard.

units.source_text: 头中将知道已被看破，可惜之余，忍不住笑起来了。

en.t: To no Chujo realized that he had been found out, and though he was disappointed, he could not help laughing.

units.source_text: 源氏公子对他说：“你是当真还是开玩笑？

en.t: Prince Genji said to him, "Are you serious, or are you joking?

units.source_text: 开玩笑也得有个限度啊！

en.t: Even a joke has to have its limits!
Let me put my clothes on properly."

units.source_text: 头中将夺取了他的衣服，死也不给他穿。

en.t: To no Chujo snatched away his clothes and absolutely refused to let him put them on.

units.source_text: 源氏公子说：“那么大家一样。”

en.t: Prince Genji said, "Then we shall both be the same."

units.source_text: 便伸手拉下了他的腰带，想剥他的衣服。

en.t: He then reached out, pulled down To no Chujo's sash, and tried to strip off his clothes.

units.source_text: 头中将不让他剥，用力抵抗。

en.t: To no Chujo would not let him do it and resisted with all his strength.

units.source_text: 两人扭作一堆，你争我夺。

en.t: The two of them became tangled together, each struggling and grabbing at the other.

units.source_text: 裂帛一声，源氏公子的衣服竟被撕破了。

en.t: With the sound of ripping silk, Prince Genji's clothes were torn after all.
To no Chujo, moved by the moment, composed and chanted:
